types.explanation: User name for authentication; first command after control connection is established.
Password for user authentication; must follow USER command.
Account information for privileged access; may be sent after PASS.
Change working directory to the specified path.
Change to parent directory; special case of CWD without argument.
Mount a different file system data structure.
Logout and close control connection.
Reinitialize login state; flushes user, password, account info.
Specify client IP and port for active data connection.
Request server to enter passive mode and listen for data connection.
Set representation type to ASCII (NVT-ASCII).
Set representation type to EBCDIC.
Set representation type to Image (binary).
Set representation type to Local byte; requires a byte size parameter.
Set file structure to File (no record structure).
Set file structure to Record structure.
Set file structure to Page structure.
Set transfer mode to Stream.
Set transfer mode to Block.
Set transfer mode to Compressed.
Retrieve a copy of the specified file from server to client.
Store data from client to server, creating or overwriting a file.
Store file under a unique name generated by the server.
Append data to an existing file, or create if file does not exist.
Allocate storage space for a file before transfer (often treated as NOOP).
Set restart marker for interrupted data transfer; must be followed by RETR or STOR.
Specify old pathname for rename; must be followed by RNTO.
Specify new pathname for rename; must follow RNFR.
Abort previous FTP service command and close data connection.
Delete the specified file on the server.
Remove the specified directory.
Create the specified directory.
Print working directory; return current directory name.
List files in a directory (or file info) over data connection.
List directory names only over data connection.
Site-specific command; parameters defined by server.
Return operating system type of server.
Request status; may be sent during transfer or with pathname argument.
Request help information; optional argument specifies command name.
No operation; server returns OK reply.
Initiate security mechanism negotiation with a specified mechanism name.
Send security data (base64) as part of authentication exchange.
Set data channel protection to Clear (no security).
Set data channel protection to Safe (integrity protected).
Set data channel protection to Confidential (encryption only).
Set data channel protection to Private (integrity and encryption).
Negotiate maximum protected buffer size (decimal integer).
Clear command channel; stop requiring integrity protection for commands.
Send integrity-protected command (base64 encoded).
Send confidentiality-protected command (base64 encoded).
Send privacy-protected command (integrity and confidentiality, base64).
Request list of extended features supported by server.
Set options for a specific command (e.g., MLST fact list).
Request the transfer size of a file (in bytes for stream mode).
Request last modification time of a specified file.
Return facts about a single file or directory over control connection.
List directory contents with machine-readable facts over data connection.
Specify extended address for data connection (including protocol family, address, port).
Request extended passive mode; optional argument for specific protocol or 'ALL'.
